title: Fantasy Football Loser Flag - Last Place Punishment

Eyebrow: LAST PLACE CERTIFIED
I SUCK AT
FANTASY
FOOTBALL
Footer: ASK ANYONE IN MY LEAGUE

Product details and verified facts:
- Double-sided print for visibility from both sides
- Suitable for indoor or outdoor display
- Printed to order (each flag is made when you order)

Intent & occasions: This is intended as a loud direct punishment flag for draft parties, end-of-season events, toilet-bowl payoffs, league parties, or gag gifts. Designed for a funny, competitive, bold, good-natured humbling of the last-place manager — a self-aware confession and mock last-place award all in one.
